director.title: Director and Founder
director.bio1: With over 30 years of experience in fire protection, Miro Baclija is one of the leading experts in Croatia. He graduated from the Faculty of Mechanical Engineering and Naval Architecture in Zagreb.
director.bio2: Under his leadership, FSB Fire Protection has grown into one of the leading fire protection companies in the region, with over 300 successfully completed projects.
director.bio3: He actively participates in the development of standards and regulations and regularly educates the professional public through seminars and publications.

about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: FSB Fire Protection
about.description: Building trust through excellence in fire protection for over three decades.
about.storyParagraph1: FSB Fire Protection was founded with the goal of providing top-quality fire protection services in the market. From the very beginning, our focus has been on quality, expertise, and reliability.
about.storyParagraph2: Over more than 30 years of operation, we have completed over 300 projects for the most demanding clients - from healthcare facilities and office buildings to public infrastructure and industrial facilities.
about.storyParagraph3: Our team consists of experienced professionals with many years of experience in fire protection. We continuously educate ourselves and follow the latest trends and technologies in the industry.
about.missionStatement: To ensure the highest level of fire protection for all types of buildings by combining expert knowledge, quality materials, and professional execution.
